phases.title: Intake & human gate
phases.purpose: Authorize and structure a site launch or QA sandbox run before any external spend or deploy.
phases.entryCriteria: Operator has Launch Key and knows Production vs QA test-only intent.
phases.steps: 1) Create Project Runs row (Run Type, Launch Key, External ID, SOP Version). 2) Create CSN Sites row with matching Launch Key and Record Class. 3) Relate Site on run. 4) Create Human Gate (project_run) with Scope + Limits for this run only. 5) Wait for Approved before scope expansion.
phases.tools: Notion isolated DBs; optional GitHub issue link in Evidence URL later.
phases.notionRecords: Project Runs, CSN Sites, Human Gates, SOP Versions.
phases.properties: Launch Key, External ID, Record Class, Gate Target External ID = run External ID.
phases.evidence: Gate row URL; Site + Run URLs in Project Run Evidence URL when available.
phases.acceptance: Run and Site linked; gate Pending or Approved; QA labeled QA test-only.
phases.failure: Missing Launch Key → stop. Blanket approval language in Scope → reject gate and rewrite.
phases.humanApproval: project_run gate approves only listed Scope (e.g. Notion build, sandbox).
phases.exit: Current Phase ≥ 1; gate Approved for sandbox QA or Pending for prod.

phases.title: Domain research (expireddomains.net)
phases.purpose: Collect and vet expired domains before any purchase.
phases.entryCriteria: Phase 1 gate Approved for research; Site + Run linked.
phases.steps: 1) expireddomains.net Deleted Domains + filters. 2) Export candidates → Domain Candidates (Source=expireddomains.net). 3) Wayback/archive review per row. 4) Score relevance in Notes; pick primary. 5) Create domain_candidate Human Gate (Pending) before purchase.
phases.tools: https://www.expireddomains.net/ , https://web.archive.org/ , optional Ahrefs for DR field.
phases.notionRecords: Domain Candidates, Human Gates, Project Runs (Notes/Evidence).
phases.properties: Source, Wayback Last Good, Ahrefs DR, Status Blocked for bad history.
phases.evidence: Export file name in Notes; Wayback URLs; ranked pick on run.
phases.acceptance: ≥3 candidates logged; primary selected; purchase gate exists Pending.
phases.failure: Spam history → Blocked candidate. No gate → STOP before Phase 3 purchase prep.
phases.humanApproval: domain_candidate gate authorizes one domain + max price — not other domains.
phases.exit: Primary candidate In progress; purchase gate Pending.

phases.title: Domain selection & registration prep
phases.purpose: Finalize domain choice and prepare registration without executing payment unless gated.
phases.steps: 1) Confirm domain_candidate gate Approved for production (sandbox: document STOP if Pending). 2) Document rationale on Domain Candidates. 3) Update run Current Phase = 3.
phases.tools: Registrar UI (out of scope until Approved).
phases.notionRecords: Domain Candidates, Human Gates, Project Runs.
phases.acceptance: Rationale recorded; no payment without Approved gate.
phases.failure: Gate Rejected → select new candidate or abort run.
phases.humanApproval: domain_candidate Approved registers exactly one Target External ID.
phases.exit: Rationale complete; Phase 3 tasks Done or blocked on gate.

phases.title: DNS & hosting scaffold
phases.purpose: Plan DNS and hosting without unauthorized prod cutover.
phases.entryCriteria: Site row exists; domain direction chosen.
phases.steps: 1) CSN Knowledge runbook: DNS table. 2) Sandbox hostname plan (QA: example/staging only). 3) Optional CSN Maintenance seed for DNS review.
phases.tools: Cloudflare dashboard (document only); repo wrangler.toml reference.
phases.notionRecords: CSN Knowledge, CSN Maintenance, Site Notes.
phases.acceptance: DNS plan documented; QA sites no prod DNS.
phases.failure: Prod DNS change on QA → rollback plan and incident row.
phases.humanApproval: staging_deploy gate if staging affects real public DNS.

phases.title: Repo & CI bootstrap
phases.purpose: Attach codebase and CI evidence to the run.
phases.steps: 1) Document repo URL. 2) CSN Releases sandbox row. 3) Store GitHub Actions run URL in Release Notes.
phases.tools: GitHub; `npm run lint` locally when repo available.
phases.acceptance: Release row exists; CI link present or marked Unverified.
phases.humanApproval: None unless CI deploys to public infra (then staging gate).

phases.title: Affiliate / feed integration
phases.purpose: Wire feeds with secrets outside Notion and log sync runs.
phases.steps: 1) Knowledge article: secrets in GitHub Actions + Cloudflare only (names not values). 2) Feed Sync Runs row (simulated OK for QA). 3) Audit: no tokens in Notion.
phases.tools: GitHub Secrets; repo scripts/kpi-enrichment or feed jobs; never Notion for keys.
phases.evidence: Feed Sync Runs URL; policy article.
phases.acceptance: Sync row exists; secrets policy documented.
phases.failure: Secret pasted in Notion → redact immediately, incident row.
phases.humanApproval: None for documentation; prod feed cutover may need production_deploy.

phases.title: Content & compliance
phases.purpose: Track required compliance pages before launch.
phases.steps: 1) CSN Knowledge Policy checklist. 2) CSN Incidents for blocking gaps.
phases.acceptance: All required pages listed with owners.
phases.failure: Missing age gate → Block launch phases.
phases.humanApproval: Legal review outside Notion if required.

phases.title: SEO baseline
phases.purpose: Capture SEO opportunities and sitemap plan.
phases.steps: 1) SEO Opportunities rows. 2) Sitemap/GSC steps in Knowledge (mark Unverified until GSC proof).
phases.tools: GSC UI; optional npm run notion:sync-kpis for legacy hub only — not Launch KPI Snapshots.
phases.evidence: Opportunity rows; GSC screenshot when verified.
phases.failure: No indexable URL → stay in staging.
phases.exit: SEO tasks complete or Unverified flagged.

phases.title: Backlink outreach (gated)
phases.steps: 1) Backlink Opportunities row. 2) Paid placement → Human Gate backlink Pending with USD Limits.
phases.acceptance: Paid gate Pending; free outreach documented separately.
phases.failure: Using domain gate for backlinks → invalid, create backlink gate.
phases.humanApproval: backlink gate per target ID only.
phases.exit: Gate exists for any paid path.

phases.title: Staging deploy & QA
phases.steps: 1) CSN Releases staging Done (or sandbox). 2) staging_deploy gate if real public staging. 3) Project Run Evidence URL populated.
phases.notionRecords: CSN Releases, Human Gates, Project Runs.
phases.acceptance: Evidence URL set; QA Record Class not labeled production.

phases.title: Production deploy
phases.purpose: Gate and record production deploy — not executed in automation.
phases.steps: 1) production_deploy gate Pending. 2) CSN Releases production row Blocked. 3) QA sites: mark N/A — never prod deploy.
phases.tools: Deploy scripts only after human Approval.
phases.notionRecords: Human Gates, CSN Releases, CSN Sites Status.
phases.acceptance: No production Release Done without Approved gate.
phases.failure: Treating QA as prod → stop, fix Record Class.
phases.exit: Gate Pending or N/A for QA.

phases.title: Launch KPI snapshot & handoff
phases.purpose: Close run with KPI snapshot and maintenance handoff.
phases.entryCriteria: Prior phases complete or N/A for QA.
phases.steps: 1) Launch KPI Snapshots with Record Class matching site. 2) CSN Maintenance seeds. 3) Project Run Status Done if evidence + sandbox rules met.
phases.tools: Isolated Launch KPI Snapshots DB; legacy hub sync separate.
phases.notionRecords: Launch KPI Snapshots, CSN Maintenance, Project Runs.
phases.properties: Record Class on snapshot; maintenance Cadence.
phases.acceptance: QA snapshots excluded from production KPI views by filter.
phases.failure: Mixing QA metrics into prod reports → policy violation.
phases.exit: Run closed or explicitly In progress awaiting prod gates.
